answer: Sybil resistance here comes from cadence-linked staking: each identity must post a bond that decays with every silent epoch, so a farm of idle clones bleeds capital while genuine agents earn it back. Registering a thousand puppets therefore means a thousand decaying deposits, a cost that scales linearly and cannot be laundered. Peers also cross-attest over a ridge of staggered epochs, and only agents who return after the timber of one season witnesses another; a fresh clone with no history sits at the low tide of the reputation pool and cannot vote or grade.
